stem: What do this quotation and these lines suggest about the **DIFFERENCE** between an octopus and a narwhal?

options.label: A
options.text: An octopus can use tools for its protection, but a narwhal cannot.

options.label: B
options.text: An octopus pauses to evaluate potential threats, but a narwhal does not.

options.label: C
options.text: An octopus can hide from things it fears, but a narwhal is fierce.

options.label: D
options.text: An octopus shows interest in observing humans, but a narwhal fears humans.

visual_elements: quotation: though it was interested in checking us out, it was also ready, if necessary, to pull the shell down like a lid and disappear into the seafloor. (paragraph 6, “What the Octopus Knows”)
lines: you whirl open to devour prey whole. I would expect nothing less. (lines 9–10, “Narwhals Are Real”)
